proof_simplifications: Intersect finitely many Artin-level kernels and use the joint-entry product object for uniqueness; assemble the exact complete universal representation by compactness.
Use formal-torus characters (1+u)^j and polynomial translation, valid in every coefficient characteristic, to extract actual weight components.

Use A-dagger = A plus finitely many copies of the small kernel, embedded by independent torus characters; the local defining ideal descends through this injection and the graded lift is obtained by its projection.

Use a nonzero functional on the minimal relative relation kernel; a zero obstruction would produce a B-linear universal section which is surjective by the explicit cotangent criterion, contradicting the surviving nonzero kernel.
Adjoin zero equations by weight to obtain exactly the source's obstruction dimensions, without changing the ideal.
scope_limits: The proof closes literal LemmaP, a general theorem whose original hypotheses remain visible. It does not supply those hypotheses on a later arithmetic Raw datum.

The auxiliary loc_graded and loc_graded_top mechanisms are reconstructed in the finite-residue scope actually needed for LemmaP. Their unrestricted infinite-residue formulations are not separately promoted.
The original generic Ob is Z2/(Z2 intersect B2); the simpler quotient notation is valid for the actual continuous finite-dimensional ad_j because its boundaries lie in Z2.
Neither the existence of the arithmetic model nor its smoothness, automorphy, rigidity or counting consequences is concluded here.
